text:
sam: Drafting a new synthetic generator called 'burstlyzer' to stress kernel-selection + batching heuristics with KV warmup policies. Goal is apples-to-apples vs replay harness. PTAL, especially QPS ramps, burst shapes, and deterministic seeding.

lee: Nice name :smile: Can it emit overlapping episodic bursts + a low-rate long tail? We need that mix to surface weird batching/kind-of-cold-KV cases. Also seq-len distro must match prod.

jordan: drop the config here and I'll try it on my local harness.

sam: ```json
{
  "generator": "burstlyzer",
  "seed": 2026,
  "duration_s": 900,
  "components": [
    {"type": "base_tail", "qps": 5},
    {"type": "episodic_burst", "rate": 1200, "burst_length_s": 20, "inter_burst_s": 300, "shape": "gamma"},
    {"type": "micro_spike", "rate": 8000, "burst_length_s": 2, "repetition": "poisson"}
  ],
  "kv_warmup": {"enabled": true, "prefill_pct": 0.2, "strategy": "prefix_templates"},
  "batching": {"max_batch_size": 128, "dynamic_rules": [{"qps_gt": 150, "max_batch_size": 48, "window_ms": 25}]},
  "seq_len_hist": "prod-1w.json"
}
```

maria: ran a quick dev pass with kernel-selector logs on. Observed kernel fallback to `fp32-kernel-v2` during the ~20s bursts. p95 latency increased ~12% vs baseline.

maria: ```
[2026-06-12T14:53:02Z] kernel_select: chosen=fp32-kernel-v2 reason=throughput_est>latency_thresh
[2026-06-12T14:53:03Z] batcher: max_batch=128 -> 128 (window_ms=50)
[2026-06-12T14:53:04Z] latency: p95=212ms p50=38ms
[2026-06-12T14:53:22Z] kernel_select: chosen=fp32-kernel-v2 fallback_count=14
```

perf-bot: regression alert :warning: p95 +12% vs baseline (1719009999). job=burstlyzer-run tags=[kv_warmup:true,kernel:fallback]

sam: that's the kernel fallback we expected in extreme bursts. Two quick levers to try: (1) make batching heuristic reduce max_batch_size when instantaneous QPS per instance spikes, (2) prefilling KV cache for a fraction of requests so heavy requests hit warm path.

lee: for (1) what exact rule? propose: cap=64 tokens per batch during spikes, and tie it to kernel-selection thresholds so we avoid sending big micro-batches to the slow kernel.

sam: proposal: if instantaneous_qps > 150 => max_batch=48, else max_batch=128. also reduce aggregator window to 25ms during ramps to avoid long tail accumulation.

jordan: that should prevent the heavyweight kernel path from triggering. Reminder for apples-to-apples: run replay-harness with same `--seed 2026` and the same `seq_len_hist=prod-1w.json`. Also ensure KV priming state is seeded from the same snapshot.

maria: after applying the batch cap + KV prefill at 20% we reran. p95 dropped back near baseline (+1.5%). p50 unchanged. I'll attach perf diffs to INF-4123.

sam: awesome. I'll open a PR with the generator code, config, and a small unit test that verifies deterministic bursts with the seed. PR and ticket: INF-4123. cc @lee @jordan

lee: small nit: include a deterministic jitter generator for burst onset times so CI is reproducible across runs.

jordan: also add per-kernel selection counters to the perf report (counts and durations). super helpful to correlate with p95.

sam: will add both. thanks all :rocket:
